The platform provides educational resources, investment solutions, and tools to help investors manage their portfolios effectively. ETFSA also supports tax-free savings accounts (TFSA) and retirement accounts, making it accessible for long-term wealth building ETFSA.co.za became the target of a cyberattack, and all confidential and personal client data will be published soon.
